Terms of service

Using this website

This website is operated by TWO BROTHERS HOME, an independent retailer in Ghana. It provides product information and a shopping bag to help you compare devices. Apple, iPhone, and Apple Watch are trademarks of their respective owner; this store is not an Apple-owned store.

Prices and product information

Prices are listed in Ghana cedis (GH₵ / GHS). Listings show the specifications and prices supplied by the shop and may change. Photos and campaign illustrations are representative and do not confirm a specific device’s colour, condition, accessories, or availability. Confirm the exact product and final price with the shop before purchasing.

Your bag and online payments

Adding items to your bag or reviewing a selection does not place an order, reserve stock, or create a purchase agreement. No payment is taken through this website. Your bag is held in the current page session and resets when the page reloads or closes.

Purchases and collection

Before paying in store, confirm the exact model, storage or case size, colour, condition, battery health, repair history, included accessories, and any warranty. Our Kumasi store is at Blessing House, PZ, Store No. 24. Confirm pickup arrangements before travelling to Dr Wash, Ayensu, UCC, Cape Coast. Any delivery arrangements and charges must be agreed with the shop.

Returns and concerns

Read our refund policy for how to raise a device issue or request a return. Device-specific warranty and any additional voluntary return terms should be agreed before purchase. These terms do not exclude rights or remedies available under applicable Ghanaian law.

Responsible use

Use the website lawfully. Do not interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorised access, or misuse its content. Links to maps and other third-party services are governed by those providers’ terms and privacy policies.

Updates and contact

We may update website information and these terms. The date above identifies this version. To discuss a purchase or these terms, visit TWO BROTHERS HOME at Blessing House, PZ, Store No. 24, Kumasi, Ghana.
